name: Create a SSH signing key for the authenticated user
description: Create a SSH signing key for the authenticated user Creates an SSH signing key for the authenticated user's GitHub account. POST /user/ssh_signing_keys
context:
POST /user/ssh_signing_keys
Creates an SSH signing key for the authenticated user's GitHub account. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `write:ssh_signing_key` scope to use this endpoint.
Required: body (body)

name: Delete an SSH signing key for the authenticated user
description: Delete an SSH signing key for the authenticated user Deletes an SSH signing key from the authenticated user's GitHub account. DELETE /user/ssh_signing_keys/{ssh_signing_key_id}

name: Get an SSH signing key for the authenticated user
description: Get an SSH signing key for the authenticated user Gets extended details for an SSH signing key. GET /user/ssh_signing_keys/{ssh_signing_key_id}

name: List SSH signing keys for the authenticated user
description: List SSH signing keys for the authenticated user Lists the SSH signing keys for the authenticated user's GitHub account. GET /user/ssh_signing_keys
context:
GET /user/ssh_signing_keys
Lists the SSH signing keys for the authenticated user's GitHub account. OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `read:ssh_signing_key` scope to use this endpoint.
